hero.title: Accounting for businesses in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE
hero.subtitle: Invoices, bills, double-entry journals and reports in Arabic and English. Bills and receipts are read into drafts that a person reviews before posting.

features.sectionSubtitle: A complete platform for modern businesses

documents.title: Bills read into drafts
documents.description: Upload a bill or receipt (image or PDF) and it is read into a draft on this server. Nothing is posted until you review it.

ai.title: Optional AI on your own account
ai.description: AI is off by default. An admin can turn it on with the organization's own provider account to read documents, suggest accounts and summarise the month.

financial.title: Financial Management
financial.description: Invoicing, bills, journals, multi-currency support, and tax compliance in one place.

operations.title: Business Operations
operations.description: Inventory, manufacturing, HR, payroll, and project management fully integrated.

security.title: Security & audit trail
security.description: Each organization's data is kept apart, permissions follow each person's role, and every change is recorded in an audit log.

analytics.title: Analytics & Reporting
analytics.description: Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance and aging reports.

technology.localAi: Documents are read on this server by default. Nothing goes to an AI provider unless you turn AI on.
technology.offline: When AI is on, it runs only on your organization's own provider account, after an admin agrees.
technology.techStack: Built on open, widely used technology

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.subtitle: Create your organization and enter your opening balances.
